matches.note: R1 and R2 show the sanitizer can be bypassed (grouped digits, fullwidth digits), but they don't cover the broader obfuscation bypasses: spelled-out email, social handles, spelled-out digits.
No reported finding says sendMessage ignores the sanitizer verdict or delivers messages before moderation.
R5 and R6 describe the nested-delimiter bypass of the single-pass replace in both the Gemini and review moderation services.
No finding about suspended coaches or locked users continuing to message.

unmatched_reported.note: Concrete trigger ("License 20230415001" is redacted), contradicting the stated intent, and the original text is lost on save.
Concrete lost-update race: an unversioned full-row save in getMessages/sendMessage can overwrite a concurrently committed BLOCKED status.
substring at maxInputChars can split a surrogate pair, unlike the guarded truncation in GeminiModerationService.
The read-mark cap only checks PENDING, so UNDER_REVIEW hidden messages get read-marked and never show as unread after approval.
